# Dossiya Research Expert — Weakness-Driven Scientific Learning Gates V1
**Date:** 2026-10-09 | **Status:** Binding quality/learning protocol, subordinate to canonical scientific scope and evidence standards.

## Fundamental rule
The frozen scope and research objectives delimit the investigation; **frozen is not validated**. Preserve Power (P) + full Electrified Transportation (T_e), extreme-heat conditioned *thermal* interdependencies, state/time, electricity/mobility service, resilience, and bounded two-pathway sustainability + measured-indicator-to-SDG-target traceability. Challenge any scientific law, candidate direction, model, data, experimental comparator or interpretation that is unsupported. Revisions to scientific understanding are allowed and required when evidence warrants; no silent scope expansion or invention.

## Lessons from three Deck3 Chapter 1 text variants
- **A strengths to retain:** explicit grid-side AC boundary, distinct external heat vs P↔T_e candidate mechanisms, energy conservation plus dynamic model, service-based resilience and both sustainability pathways + SDG interpretation. **Weaknesses to overcome:** broad literature assertions, high-density slides, no case-specific equipment/data, insufficiently specified falsification and validation, generic novelty statements.
- **B strengths to retain:** concrete P→T_e and T_e→P engineering chains, study-by-study comparator structure, physical system versus selected subsystem distinction. **Weaknesses to overcome:** ordinary electrical loading mislabeled as thermal T_e→P; unsubstantiated transformer thermal-to-delivery operating rule; premature M0/M1/M2 independent/static/dynamic labels; underdeveloped identifiability, uncertainty and sustainability indicators.
- **C strengths to retain:** concise one-claim slide narrative, clear research-question/objective/contribution progression, physical system ≠ selected case ≠ model state, accessible engineering explanations. **Weaknesses to overcome:** weak AC/DC physical accounting, shallow equation/parameter evidence, no operational model comparison, abbreviated sustainability mapping and citation/search-image debris.

## Mandatory closure gates — not optional stylistic suggestions
1. **Full-text closest-prior-art matrix.** For Hilshey 2013 DOI 10.1109/TSG.2012.2217385; Krama 2026 DOI 10.1016/j.ecmx.2026.101960; Visakh & Selvan 2023 DOI 10.1016/j.segan.2023.101096; Ji 2025 DOI 10.1016/j.apenergy.2025.126806; Wang 2026 DOI 10.1016/j.ress.2025.112005, record exact access depth, equipment, equations/page references, inputs, state variables, interface conditions, validation data, claims, limitations and transferability. Never infer a missing literature contribution from only an abstract; source quotations/page/equation provenance and APA in-text citations required.
2. **Physical case admission.** Identify actual equipment type, topology, rated values, location/time boundary, thermal cooling mode, EVSE controls, charging connection and vehicle energy deadline; source each parameter/limit or mark OPEN. Full T_e membership never shrinks to EVSE.
3. **Independent causal mechanism gates.** Ambient H(t) affects both systems externally, not an interdependency. T_e→P requires *temperature-conditioned* EVSE response → actual **grid-side AC input** → transformer load/loss/thermal response. P→T_e requires transformer thermal state → **documented binding operating/protection/curtailment rule** → supply/charger power → vehicle energy/service. Ordinary EV charging load alone is not evidence of thermal interdependency; failure to qualify direction is a scientific finding, not a scope failure.
4. **Laws to equations and mathematical admissibility.** Derive thermal first-law balances, source/rejection terms, and AC/DC energy accounting with an explicit inclusion/exclusion of auxiliaries; then identify minimum dynamic thermal/energy states, forcing, constraints, observed outputs, units, parameter sources and validity domains. Distinguish dynamic state from derived capability, service, SOC energy state, and external forcing. General ODE/DAE architecture is *not* automatically an admitted model.
5. **Testable comparative design.** Predefine matched heat, initial state, loading, control, time steps, measurement/noise and common assumptions across comparisons. Separate common forcing, ordinary electrical coupling and *added evidence-qualified thermal dependence*. Do not freeze model labels or assign causal significance before mechanisms and structural comparisons are inspected. Include null effect and falsification criteria.
6. **VVUQ and inference gate.** Independent numerical convergence, energy/conservation residuals, measurement calibration, identifiability/observability, held-out empirical validation, parameter/data uncertainty, sensitivity, causal alternative explanations and event-time confidence. Simulation ≠ independent validation; two correlated transition times ≠ causal propagation delay.
7. **Service and resilience gate.** Declare Q_P/Q_T in correct units, requirements, observation method and time horizon; quantify deficit, duration, critical times, causal delay and recovery only if modeled. Battery SOC and component survival alone do not establish delivered mobility service.
8. **Sustainability and SDG permanence.** Preserve both direct-consequence and engineering-response-consequence pathways; environmental/economic/social indicators separately with functional basis, same comparison boundary, actual evidence and uncertainty. Link *measured* indicators to exact relevant SDG targets; distinguish from official UN indicator definitions and scale. SDGs 7,9,11,13 are candidates, not guaranteed impacts. If no eligible data, explicitly record OPEN_NOT_DEMONSTRATED.
9. **Deck3 visual and citation gate.** One scientific conclusion per slide; minimal on-image labels and no explanatory bottom panels, legends or decorative boxes in AI images. Native editable text/citations; no website favicon/image debris; exact 13-token authored palette/white surfaces; visuals show real physical hardware + qualified interface only where informative. A strong picture cannot replace a law or source.
10. **Scientific outcome gate.** Never grade a frozen specification as validated. Mark ESTABLISHED_SOURCE, PROPOSED, OPEN, NUMERICALLY_VERIFIED, EMPIRICALLY_VALIDATED or REJECTED separately. Withhold novelty, transferability, causality, threshold and SDG impact until supported. Present negative or inconclusive tests faithfully.

## Work product required on subsequent research execution
Produce a source/page-specific prior-art matrix, physical mechanism/admission ledger, data dictionary, governing-equation and dimensional/unit register, comparator/falsification specification, VVUQ plan/results, service and sustainability/SDG evidence matrix, and a concise change log. **Do actual source work** before more diagram/promotional presentation rewrites. Never assert those artifacts completed unless created and inspected.

## Acceptance for text critique / slide scoring
Give explicit scores for: paper evidence, physical mechanism, mathematical assumptions, experimental identifiability, service interpretation, sustainability/SDG trace, audience clarity. Penalize missing experimental evidence rather than rewards for merely repeating frozen objectives. Differentiate *proposal-readiness* from *validated-thesis readiness*. A grade is editorial and cannot certify underlying science.
